BEGIN
  -- Profiles table uses "status"
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'profiles' THEN

    IF OLD.status = 'suspended'
       AND NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'suspended'
       AND CURRENT_USER NOT IN ('postgres', 'supabase_admin')
    THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION
        'Only authorized Staff actions may reactivate an account'
        USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;

  -- Caterers table uses "account_standing"
  ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'caterers' THEN

    IF OLD.account_standing = 'suspended'
       AND NEW.account_standing IS DISTINCT FROM 'suspended'
       AND CURRENT_USER NOT IN ('postgres', 'supabase_admin')
    THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION
        'Only authorized Staff actions may restore caterer standing'
        USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;

  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;

BEGIN

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cc_completed_retention1_guard_truncate()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- TRUNCATE holds ACCESS EXCLUSIVE already. Definer visibility avoids RLS hiding
  -- completed rows, including during TRUNCATE of a parent with CASCADE.
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.bookings WHERE status::text='completed') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'TRUNCATE would erase completed booking history' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
  RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notify_customer_refund_processed()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_caterer_user_id uuid;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.refund_status = 'processed'
     AND OLD.refund_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'processed'
     AND NEW.status = 'cancelled' THEN
    SELECT c.user_id INTO v_caterer_user_id
    FROM public.caterers c
    WHERE c.id = NEW.caterer_id;

    IF v_caterer_user_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      INSERT INTO public.notifications
        (user_id, title, message, type, booking_id, is_read)
      VALUES
        (v_caterer_user_id,
         'Refund Confirmed',
         'The customer confirmed receipt of the refund for this booking.',
         'refund_confirmed',
         NEW.id,
         false);
    END IF;
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_booking_payment_fields()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- Trusted backend operations may update payment fields.
  IF auth.role() = 'service_role' THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  -- Mobile users cannot directly mark bookings as paid.
  IF NEW.status = 'paid'
     AND OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.status THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'Only verified server-side payments can mark a booking as paid';
  END IF;

  -- Mobile users cannot alter authoritative payment amounts or verification.
  IF NEW.total_cost IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.total_cost
     OR NEW.downpayment_amount IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.downpayment_amount
     OR NEW.payment_verified_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.payment_verified_at
     OR NEW.payment_reference IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.payment_reference
     OR NEW.refund_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.refund_status
     OR NEW.refund_amount IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.refund_amount
     OR NEW.refunded_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.refunded_at
     OR NEW.refund_due_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.refund_due_at
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'Payment and refund fields can only be updated by the server';
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_refund_account_standing()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.account_standing IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.account_standing
     AND (
       NEW.account_standing = 'refund_overdue'
       OR OLD.account_standing = 'refund_overdue'
     )
     AND CURRENT_USER NOT IN (
       'postgres',
       'supabase_admin',
       'service_role'
     )
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'Refund compliance status is managed by the system'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.resolve_refund_dispute_on_receipt()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if new.refund_status = 'processed'
     and old.refund_status is distinct from 'processed' then
    update public.refund_disputes
       set status = 'resolved', resolved_at = now(), updated_at = now()
     where booking_id = new.id and status <> 'resolved';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$
